purpose: Teach: 増田/古田/川上/水野/古川/桜井/平田/西田

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、経済学者増田先生の論文を、論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered economist Masuda's paper in your essay, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gentle confirmation seeking—not quizzing, but drawing Sakura into shared reference. Clear and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、歴史学者古田先生のご研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered historian Furuta's research in my paper.
lines.style: Straightforward and clear. Direct eye contact energy. Calm confidence—not overexplaining, trusting the teacher understands. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会学者川上先生のフィールド調査を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered sociologist Kawakami's field research work, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured tone. Slight pause after the opening—genuinely reflecting on what she's heard. Warm curiosity, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、文学者水野先生の古典分析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered literary scholar Mizuno's classical text analysis in my paper.
lines.style: Clear and poised. Small breath before speaking—gathering her thoughts. Calm articulation. The voice of someone who's done the work and knows it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人類学者古川先生の地域研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also covered anthropologist Furukawa's regional study work, didn't you?
lines.style: Gently reflective. Light acknowledgment in the voice. Building a pattern—noticing the scope of her work. Warm and observant, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、考古学者桜井先生の発掘成果を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered archaeologist Sakurai's excavation findings in my paper.
lines.style: Confident and clear. A touch of quiet pride in the steadiness. Direct delivery—this is factual, this is done. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 言語学者平田先生の音韻研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you incorporated linguist Hirata's phonological research as well?
lines.style: Impressed, but gently so. A small knowing smile in the voice. Recognizing the breadth of her scholarship. Warm and genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、哲学者西田幾多郎先生の思想を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered philosopher Nishida Kitarō's thought in my paper.
lines.style: Firm, complete closure. Slight emphasis on the name—respecting the figure, grounding the work in something substantial. The final confirmation, delivered with quiet certainty.
